armor.copper.name: Copper Armor
armor.copper.description: Copper plates laced together with fiber. Crude, but better than nothing.
armor.iron.name: Iron Armor
armor.iron.description: Solid iron plating over the old copper. Heavy, dependable and hard to dent.
armor.gold.name: Gold Armor
armor.gold.description: Gold-clad and well balanced. Swings seem to land a little harder in it.
armor.iridium.name: Iridium Armor
armor.iridium.description: A shimmering alloy that seems to invite good fortune.
armor.radioactive.name: Radioactive Armor
armor.radioactive.description: It hums faintly and sharpens every strike. Probably don't sleep in it.
armor.dragonscale.name: Dragonscale Armor
armor.dragonscale.description: Forged in the volcano's heat, it's light enough to run in.
armor.prismatic.name: Prismatic Armor
armor.prismatic.description: Shifts through every color and draws nearby treasures toward you.
armor.infinity.name: Infinity Armor
armor.infinity.description: The stars themselves are woven through it. Nothing else comes close.
mail.prismatic-armor: @,^Word travels fast: you've claimed the Galaxy Sword.^Prismatic shards can do more than make a blade. Combine three of them with five iridium bars and your dragonscale armor, and you'll have something worthy of it.^   -Clint[#]Prismatic Armor
